title: Works, Pretty Well
text: Works, Pretty Well. Wasn't crazy about the color but had gotten tired of thin coozies not keeping the beverages cold. This easily doubles the time you have before your drink starts to warm up when wrapped with a piece of foam. Will probably get a can of engine enamel paint and do this up more in my style.

product_metadata.title: 4 in 1 Slim Can Cooler for 12 OZ Skinny Can, Regular Can & Beer Bottle, Keep Cold for 6 Hours, Double Walled Stainless Steel Vacuum Beverage Can Insulator(Black)
features: 【CAN HOLD 12 OUNCES OF BOTTLED/CANNED BEVERAGES】Our vacuum insulated can cooler is suitable for 12 ounces of fine cans, short cans and bottled beer, cola, coffee, energy drinks, soda, etc. You can also use it as a cooling cup for your favorite ice milkshakes, smoothies and juices. Wait for mixed drinks. No matter which beverage you like, this 4-in-1 Cooler can keep your drinks cool and fresh, and have a great time in the hottest summer!

【EXCELLENT DOUBLE-LAYER INNER WALL DESIGN】High-quality stainless steel cans and bottle insulators, cans with slender double inner walls, can provide excellent thermal insulation performance, and can ensure that the beverages remain fresh for several hours. Finger grooves and portable size (3 inches * 6 inches) provide a more comfortable and firm grip! Keep the drink fresh and cold to the last drop.

【NON-SLIP, DRY】The embedded silicone bottom can prevent the beverage cooler from slipping, overflowing or scratching. The sweat-proof appearance means that you can hold the beer comfortably, and its non-condensing design keeps your hands dry, no matter how long you drink, your palms will not sweat and will not leave unsightly condensation rings.

【EASY TO USE】It only takes one step to keep the drink cool. You can insert the bottle/jar into the cooler and hold it firmly in place by loading and locking the gasket without rattling. Unscrew the gasket and slide it into your canned beverage when needed. Just rinse with water.

【THE PERFECT GIFT】This compact vacuum insulated tank cooler is small and durable, making it a perfect gift for anyone who likes cold drinks. You can take it with you whenever and wherever, beach parties, garden barbecues, camping, road trips, etc.
